summary: Feed s132_double is degraded: 100% of packets are untagged (required VLANs 10, 20 missing) and SIEM 1 Gbps port is overloaded by 1.70 Gbps bursts (170% capacity, 7 intervals).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is stripping 802.1Q tags or TAP/SPAN source is access-port/untagged. All packets seen are untagged while SIEM requires VLANs 10 and 20 for tenant/context separation, so 100% miss rate.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM cannot filter, correlate, or report by VLAN/tenant; detection coverage for VLAN 10, 20 is blind and compliance/context is lost.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve 802.1Q tags end-to-end from TAP through packet broker to SIEM so VLAN 10,20 are visible for filtering and correlation.

findings.root_cause: Microbursts peak at 1.70 Gbps in 1 ms intervals vs 1 Gbps SIEM port capacity (170% of line rate). Sustained burst rate exceeds tool NIC/buffer, seen in 7 overloaded intervals.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM NIC drops packets during bursts, causing missed events, incomplete flows, and gaps in detection/correlation despite SIEM not needing full payload or both directions.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute bursts across 2x1G or 10G SIEM inputs or add load-balanced tool group to absorb 1.7 Gbps peaks and prevent tail drops; alternatively filter to required VLANs/flows to reduce load.
